_about: Public-domain Hannah More (1745-1833), evangelical writer, educator and abolitionist of the Clapham circle, for the Word Hoard: Practical Piety (1811), Christian Morals (New York, 1813), Strictures on the Modern System of Female Education (eleventh edition, 1811), her Works (vol. V of the 1801 eight-volume set, vol. I of the 1834 set, vol. I of the Harper 1843), and Essays on Various Subjects (1777), Coelebs in Search of a Wife and The Shepherd of Salisbury Plain from Project Gutenberg, from Internet Archive scans and Project Gutenberg. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 34 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

hmore-essays-1777: Essays on Various Subjects, Principally Designed for Young Ladies (London: J. Wilkie and T. Cadell, 1777)
hmore-coelebs: Coelebs in Search of a Wife (New York: Derby & Jackson, 1858)
hmore-shepherd-salisbury: The Shepherd of Salisbury Plain, and Other Tales (New York: Derby & Jackson, 1859)

hmore-practical-piety: Practical Piety, or the Influence of the Religion of the Heart on the Conduct of the Life (London: T. Cadell and W. Davies, 1811)
hmore-christian-morals: Christian Morals, first American from the fourth London edition (New York: Eastburn, Kirk, 1813)
hmore-strictures-1: Strictures on the Modern System of Female Education, eleventh edition, vol. I (London: T. Cadell and W. Davies, 1811)
hmore-strictures-2: Strictures on the Modern System of Female Education, eleventh edition, vol. II (London: T. Cadell and W. Davies, 1811)
hmore-works-1801-5: The Works of Hannah More, in eight volumes, vol. V (London: A. Strahan for T. Cadell jun. and W. Davies, 1801)
hmore-works-1834-1: The Works of Hannah More, with a memoir and notes, vol. I (London: H. Fisher, R. Fisher, and P. Jackson, 1834)
hmore-works-1843-1: The Works of Hannah More, first complete American edition, vol. I (New York: Harper & Brothers, 1843)

_alternates.hmore-copies: Coelebs first edition (1808) and seventh (1809), both anonymous; the Harper 1843 vol. II (no title page in the OCR); the 1830 eleven-volume Works and the 1799 first Strictures (not read)

_rights_checked.hmore-coelebs: PG header has no copyright marker; the 1808 and 1809 Cadell editions are anonymous, so the shelf takes this edition, which names her
